title: Micro-hydrogel molding-assisted fabrication of a PDMS-based microfluidic concentration-gradient generator for dynamic anticancer drug testing
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,21026-21035
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02192H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Dhruba Dhar, Jyotirmoy Chatterjee, Soumen Das
A frugal microfluidic concentration gradient generator was developed without the requirement of clean-room conditions. Device performance was validated theoretically and experimentally, and drug dose–response analysis was conducted on cancer cells.
